oman-2022.notes: Source 1 is a news report of OCPC 2019 (6th edition, hosted by the SQU Department of Computer Science, began Sunday 13 October 2019, two-day competition, 152 participants in 36 teams from 23 institutions); it belongs to oman-2019, not oman-2022.

sources.disagreement: The earlier reader found an unrelated crawl without the article; our copy is now the named article itself, a news report of OCPC 2019, not of 2022.
sources.evidence: SQU Anwaar news article 'SQU Hosts Oman Collegiate Programming Contest' dated 13 Oct 2019 about the 6th edition (OCPC 2019), with 152 participants in 36 teams from 23 institutions.

oman-2024.notes: University of Buraimi news item (address: College of Engineering participates in the 10th edition of the OCPC) was captured as an empty client-rendered shell; a capture with the article text (rendered, or Wayback) is needed. If readable it is more likely a report than web.
